Home.intro: Food, education and healthcare for people in need, especially in rural and marginalised communities.
Home.visionText: A society where every individual has access to food, education and healthcare, enabling people to live with dignity, equality and opportunity.
Home.missionText: To serve humanity through meaningful initiatives in nutrition, education and healthcare, reaching underserved communities through sustainable, inclusive and community-driven action.
Home.founderCommitment: Our commitment is to serve humanity, strengthen communities and create a society where everyone has the opportunity to flourish.

Founder.name: Sidrameshwar S. Wale
Founder.mottoMeaning: May all people be happy and prosperous.
Founder.bio1: Driven by the belief that meaningful social transformation begins with serving humanity, Sidrameshwar S. Wale founded Sidhomarg Foundation with a vision of building an inclusive, compassionate and empowered society.
Founder.bio2: His philosophy centres on three fundamental pillars of human well-being — Anna (Food), Akshara (Education) and Arogya (Health). Through these three pillars, the Foundation seeks to address essential social needs, support underserved communities and create opportunities for a dignified and better quality of life.
Founder.philosophy: Save Humanity. Strengthen Communities. Build a Flourishing Society.

About.title: Who We Are
About.about1: Sidhomarg Foundation is a registered charitable trust committed to human well-being, social responsibility and inclusive community development. Guided by the philosophy of Sarve Janah Sukhino Bhavantu, we believe every individual deserves dignity, opportunity and access to life’s basic necessities.
About.about2: Our mission is rooted in three fundamental pillars: Anna (Food), Akshara (Education) and Arogya (Health). Through these pillars, we aspire to address hunger, promote education and improve community health, particularly among underserved populations.
About.about3: Driven by compassion, collective participation and selfless service, we strive to empower communities, protect human dignity and create lasting social impact.
About.tagline: Save Humanity. Strengthen Communities. Build a Flourishing Society.
About.mottoText: “Sarve Janah Sukhino Bhavantu” means: may all people be happy and prosperous.

Careers.title: Work with us for Anna, Akshara and Arogya.
Careers.intro: Sidhomarg Foundation is looking for people who want to put their skills to work for the community. Choose a role below to apply by email.

socialMedia.title: Social Media Manager
socialMedia.description: Share the Foundation's work, events and stories on social media, and help more people learn about Anna, Akshara and Arogya.

website.title: Website Manager
website.description: Keep this website up to date in English and Kannada, add photos and news from the field, and make sure it works well for every visitor.

legal.title: Legal Consultant
legal.description: Advise the Foundation on legal and compliance matters so that its work stays on a sound footing.
